title: 4-round AES-256: projected equality and finite-sample filter

target.description: AES-256: rounds2–5 map I2 to O5; each internal round includes MixColumns and standard left ShiftRows. The article explicitly targets AES-192/256.

setting.key_relation: Four fixed, unknown round keys. Master-key dependencies are not used in the component argument.
setting.key_population: general secret key; no restriction to a weak-key family
setting.plaintext_model: Fix the12 bytes outside column0 of I2. The active function input is I2_00; (I2_10,I2_20,I2_30) is a three-byte parameter.
assumptions: Birthday collision estimates assume random-like32-bit internal tuples; the approximate0.5 source estimate is distinct from exact distinguishing advantage.

property.statement: Under a common fixed round5 key, equality of I5_00 is equivalent to equality of the inverse-MixColumns projection of column0 of O5. The source uses25 active-input values as a heuristic wrong-key filter.
property.quantifier: The pointwise equality equivalence holds for each input pair under the same key. Extending25 sampled matches to function equality relies on the paper's independent wrong-key model; it is not a deterministic implication.
property.scope: Four internal rounds2–5. Equation(5)'s absolute equality to Sbox(I5_00) omits a fixed key offset present in Equation(4); that offset cancels in a same-key pairwise comparison.

parameters.name: Projection coefficients
parameters.meaning: First row of inverse MixColumns applied to output column0.

parameters.name: Filter length
parameters.meaning: Twenty-five, not2^25; used in the selected-round-key search.

parameters.name: Wrong-candidate match
parameters.meaning: Source independence heuristic for one192-bit round-key guess, not an attack-success probability.

parameters.name: Nominal candidate multiplier
parameters.meaning: The source's false-match argument for192 guessed round-key bits; no new population success estimate is inferred.

validation.description: Local independent AES checks verify the offset-corrected projection and Equation(6) inversion for64 samples. With sequential-byte keys and zero I5, raw projections are be/cd while Sbox(00)=63; the missing offsets are dd/ae for AES-192/256. This checks component identities only.

field_conflicts.label: Projection key offset
field_conflicts.description: Equation(4) retains the transformed round5 key, while Equation(5) equates the raw output projection directly with Sbox(I5_00). Pairwise equality under the same key survives because the fixed offset cancels.

observations.reported: Sbox(I5) equals the transformed output XOR the transformed round5 key.
The displayed absolute equality to Sbox(I5_00) contains no round5 key offset.

field_conflicts.label: Search-wide key-pair witness multiplicity
field_conflicts.description: Printed2^192*2^-200 covers one fixed pair of structures. If all unordered pairs among2^16 structures are searched, under that same per-key/per-fixed-pair2^-200 model the expected wrong-key/pair witness count is2^192*C(2^16,2)*2^-200=8,388,480 (log2≈23), not2^-8. This is neither a distinct-wrong-key count nor an actual AES false-positive probability; its expectation alone does not establish high error probability. No corrected whole-attack success/time is inferred.

observations.reported: 2^16 structures; choose two distinct structures for the collision search.
